scripts.build: vite build && powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path 'api') { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'dist/api'; Get-ChildItem -Path 'api/*' -Exclude 'share.db' | Copy-Item -Destination 'dist/api' -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path '.htaccess') { Copy-Item -Path '.htaccess' -Destination 'dist' -Force }"
